select
  cluster_name,
  '存储使用日增量（GB）' as key,
  'es.node.capacity.daily.inc' as item,
  cast(value / 1024 / 1024 / 1024 as string) as value
from
  xiejiandb.dws_zbx_daily_statistics
where
  key = 'es.cluster.capacity.increase'
  and ds = '2023-04-17'
union all
select
  aa.cluster_name,
  '存储日增长率' as key,
  'es.node.capacity.daily.inc.percent' as item,
  concat(round(aa.inc / bb.total, 4) * 100, '%') as value
from
  (
    select
      cluster_name,
      value as inc
    from
      xiejiandb.dws_zbx_daily_statistics
    where
      key = 'es.cluster.capacity.increase'
      and ds = '2023-04-17'
  ) aa
  join (
    select
      cluster_name,
      value as total
    from
      xiejiandb.dws_zbx_daily_statistics
    where
      key = 'es.cluster.capacity.total'
      and ds = '2023-04-17'
  ) bb on aa.cluster_name = bb.cluster_name
union all
select
  aa.cluster_name,
  '最近存储正增长三十天日增量均值(GB)' as key,
  'es.node.capacity.d30.inc.average' as item,
  cast(
    case
      when bb.total_count == 0 then 0
      else aa.total_inc / bb.total_count
    end as string
  ) as value
from
  (
    select
      cluster_name,
      sum(value) as total_inc,
      ds
    from
      xiejiandb.dws_zbx_daily_statistics
    where
      key = 'es.cluster.capacity.increase'
      and value >= 0
    group by
      cluster_name,
      ds
    order by
      ds desc
    limit
      30
  ) aa
  join (
    select
      cluster_name,
      count(1) as total_count,
      ds
    from
      xiejiandb.dws_zbx_daily_statistics
    where
      key = 'es.cluster.capacity.increase'
      and value >= 0
    group by
      cluster_name,
      ds
    order by
      ds desc
    limit
      30
  ) bb on aa.cluster_name = bb.cluster_name
union all
select
  aa.cluster_name,
  '预测日增长量（GB）' as key,
  'es.node.capacity.daily.inc.estimate' as item,
  cast(
    case
      when bb.total_count == 0 then 0
      else aa.total_inc / bb.total_count
    end as string
  ) as value
from
  (
    select
      cluster_name,
      sum(value) as total_inc,
      ds
    from
      xiejiandb.dws_zbx_daily_statistics
    where
      key = 'es.cluster.capacity.increase'
      and value >= 0
    group by
      cluster_name,
      ds
    order by
      ds desc
  ) aa
  join (
    select
      cluster_name,
      count(1) as total_count,
      ds
    from
      xiejiandb.dws_zbx_daily_statistics
    where
      key = 'es.cluster.capacity.increase'
      and value >= 0
    group by
      cluster_name,
      ds
    order by
      ds desc
  ) bb on aa.cluster_name = bb.cluster_name
union all
select
  cc.cluster_name,
  '预计可支撑天数（超80%线，预测日增量为0，该值为9999）' as key,
  'es.node.capacity.daily.available' as item,
  case
    when cc.predict_inc == 0 then '9999'
    else cast(
      round(dd.total_of_day * 0.8 / cc.predict_inc, 2) as string
    )
  end as value
from
  (
    select
      aa.cluster_name as cluster_name,
      case
        when bb.total_count == 0 then 0
        else aa.total_inc / bb.total_count
      end as predict_inc
    from
      (
        select
          cluster_name,
          sum(value) as total_inc,
          ds
        from
          xiejiandb.dws_zbx_daily_statistics
        where
          key = 'es.cluster.capacity.increase'
          and value >= 0
        group by
          cluster_name,
          ds
        order by
          ds desc
      ) aa
      join (
        select
          cluster_name,
          count(1) as total_count,
          ds
        from
          xiejiandb.dws_zbx_daily_statistics
        where
          key = 'es.cluster.capacity.increase'
          and value >= 0
        group by
          cluster_name,
          ds
        order by
          ds desc
      ) bb on aa.cluster_name = bb.cluster_name
  ) cc
  join (
    select
      cluster_name,
      value as total_of_day
    from
      xiejiandb.dws_zbx_daily_statistics
    where
      key = 'es.cluster.capacity.total'
      and ds = '2023-04-17'
  ) dd on cc.cluster_name = dd.cluster_name
union all
select
  cluster_name,
  '当日tps峰值' as key,
  'es.tps.daily.maximum' as item,
  cast(max(value) as string) as value
from
  xiejiandb.dws_zbx_daily_statistics
where
  key = 'es.tps.daily.max'
  and ds = '2023-04-17'
group by
  cluster_name
union all
select
  aa.cluster_name as cluster_name,
  '七天内tps均值' as key,
  'es.tps.d7.average' as item,
  case
    when bb.total_days == 0 then '0'
    else cast(round(total_sum / total_days) as string)
  end as value
from
  (
    (
      select
        cluster_name,
        sum(daily_total_sum) as total_sum
      from
        (
          select
            cluster_name,
            sum(value) as daily_total_sum,
            ds
          from
            xiejiandb.dws_zbx_daily_statistics
          where
            key = 'es.tps.daily.average'
          group by
            cluster_name,
            ds
          order by
            ds desc
          limit
            7
        ) a1
      group by
        cluster_name
    ) aa
    join (
      select
        cluster_name,
        count(day) as total_days
      from
        (
          select
            cluster_name,
            count(1) as day,
            ds
          from
            xiejiandb.dws_zbx_daily_statistics
          where
            key = 'es.tps.daily.average'
          group by
            cluster_name,
            ds
          order by
            ds desc
          limit
            7
        ) a2
      group by
        cluster_name
    ) bb on aa.cluster_name = bb.cluster_name
  )
union all
select
  cluster_name,
  '集群理论tps峰值' as key,
  'es.tps.theory.maximum' as item,
  cast(max(value) as string) as value
from
  xiejiandb.dws_zbx_daily_statistics
where
  key = 'es.tps.daily.max'
group by
  cluster_name
union all
select
  aa.cluster_name,
  '集群tps使用率' as key,
  'es.tps.used.percent' as item,
  concat(
    round(aa.daily_max / bb.cluster_max, 4) * 100,
    '%'
  ) as value
from
  (
    (
      select
        cluster_name,
        '当日tps峰值' as key,
        max(value) as daily_max
      from
        xiejiandb.dws_zbx_daily_statistics
      where
        key = 'es.tps.daily.max'
        and ds = '2023-04-17'
      group by
        cluster_name
    ) aa
    join (
      select
        cluster_name,
        '集群理论tps峰值' as key,
        max(value) as cluster_max
      from
        xiejiandb.dws_zbx_daily_statistics
      where
        key = 'es.tps.daily.max'
      group by
        cluster_name
    ) bb on aa.cluster_name = bb.cluster_name
  )
union all
select
  cluster_name,

            7
